decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith ( Design and Access Statement, Vertical Sliding Sash Drawing, Drawing Numbers SC20917/1, SC20917/2, Photo Montage, Window Sample received 09/05/11) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the double glazing have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Replacement of existing UPVC coated aluminium sash windows with new double glazed  UPVC sash windows on ground floor flat and first floor flat.
